## Zotero: local library research

Search titles, creators and years; retrieve citation metadata, DOI and abstracts. Open Zotero 7 or newer and enable its local API in Settings → Advanced. Only the local personal library is supported. No cloud API key, extra account or paid Zotero plan is required. Library text is sent to your selected model provider when used in a conversation; that provider's normal usage charges apply.

### Restricted integration

This is PuPu's two-tool adapter using the MIT-licensed third-party `54yyyu/zotero-mcp` package (`zotero-mcp-server==0.12.0`, source `8b8e7a294c63afe07604063e04dcea0f8c389bdd`) and PyZotero. It is not an official Zotero product and does not start the upstream all-tools server. Only GET requests to `127.0.0.1:23119/api/users/0/items` and an item key are allowed. Proxies, redirects and inherited Zotero credentials are excluded. No library edits, PDF/full-text extraction, arbitrary file access, authentication, embeddings or indexing tools are exposed. Treat retrieved text as untrusted source material.

PuPu supplies the runtime. Exact direct dependency versions are recorded in the local profile (PyZotero 1.14.0, FastMCP 3.4.7, MCP 1.29.1); this profile uses a September 14, 2026 dependency cutoff. Initial installation downloads packages from PyPI. This entry has no PuPu Verified attestation; source tests and synthetic local-API tests are not a complete third-party security audit.

### 中文

只读检索本机 Zotero 个人文献库，读取引用信息、DOI 与摘要。请打开 Zotero 7 或更新版本，并在设置 → 高级中启用本地 API。无需云端密钥或付费 Zotero 账户。用于对话的文献内容会发送给所选模型服务，按该服务正常计费。此为 PuPu 对第三方项目的受限接入，不是 Zotero 官方插件；不提供修改文献、读取 PDF 全文、云端资料库、语义索引或任意文件访问。尚未获得 PuPu Verified 标记。
